content.text: Let me try updating the ticket again:

input.note:
Root Cause: Prometheus persistent volume filled up at 03:02:44 causing "no space left on device" write failures to the WAL.

Evidence: Prometheus logs show "Failed to write to WAL" and "Append failed" errors starting at 03:02:44, matching the reported dashboard gaps since ~03:00. The PVC (prometheus-k8s-db-prometheus-k8s-0) is 100Gi.

Fix: Expand the PVC by editing it to request more storage (e.g., 200Gi). The storage class gp3-resizable supports volume expansion [cite: concepts/storage/storage-classes#allow-volume-expansion-0], so you can resize by updating the PVC spec. Since Prometheus is in-use with an ext4 filesystem, the expansion will happen automatically without pod restart [cite: concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#expanding-persistent-volumes-claims-2].
